## TransferStore.issueDownloadLink() method

Exchange a grant presented by `subject` for a fresh download link to its file. Every call issues a new link.

**Signature:**

```typescript
issueDownloadLink(subject: string, grantToken: string): Promise<IssuedDownloadLink>;
```
